pages: Scope, status and how to use the package

This manual consolidates two supplied intestinal cell playbooks into one scientific specification and one executable rule registry. The target is an adult human ileal mucosal microdomain initialized with 100 individual cells. Each agent represents one cell, not a cohort. The initial population is not a conservation law: division, vascular entry, shedding, death and clearance change different population counts.
The two deliverables serve different purposes

The manual explains biological scope, supporting experiments, spatial constraints, mathematical choices, time origins, uncertainty and validation. The JSON specifies predicates, candidate features, numerical demonstration parameters, action clocks, resource reservations and typed completion effects. The accompanying native JavaScript kernel executes the decision and event layer. Geometry, mechanics, recognition, spatial data initialization and physical completion transactions remain the responsibility of the host simulator.

All runnable numerical values are explicitly proposed settings, P. No human secretion rate, receptor threshold, death hazard or spatial diffusion coefficient has been estimated from patient data here. No expression matrix, segmentation image or live imaging trajectory was fitted during this consolidation. The reference kernel therefore runs a demonstration profile and rejects research mode. A future calibrated version requires an external fit, its data provenance and independent validation, not a change to a display label.
A source does not license every number beside it

A source supporting a receptor pathway may not support the selected threshold, delay, outcome probability or spatial range. An atlas supporting a fibroblast state may not support a causal conversion rule. This manual keeps source observations, transfer assumptions and numerical choices separate. The registry attaches references to each action and explicitly states whether their role is association or experimental context.

Load the registry and validate it. Supply a physical and molecular snapshot with declared provenance. Evaluate eligible actions, sample initiation by channel, retain event clocks, and apply completed effects only through an acknowledged atomic transaction. Missing contact, target recognition, resources or host physics must reject the action. Missing information must not be replaced with an apparently plausible biological default.

The package contains software contract tests and a one cell integration demonstration. Neither is a fitted virtual intestine. Patient specific outcome prediction, pharmacology and pathogen replication kinetics are not implemented.
What was retained, added and corrected

The supplied documents agree on a useful central contract: cell identity restricts the action vocabulary; local context determines eligibility; an explicit clock separates initiation from completion; and each completed action changes the environment. The second document adds a clearer licence, trigger, kinetics and consequence structure, broader stromal and optional cell coverage, explicit exposure memory, and a useful separation between physical execution and a language model proposal. These features are retained. [S01, S02]
Retained and expanded to include units, ownership of resources, cancellation, host capabilities and measurable completion.
Retained, with separate initiation hazards and sampled completion durations. A clock is not resampled every tick.
Retained as transport and contact mechanisms. No cell reads a distant source identity or global infection map.
Retained. Basal flux, induced output capacity, stored release and replenishment are different processes.
Stromal diversity and rare cell extensions
Expanded into a 28 type dictionary. Specialized optional functions stay disabled when their host modules are absent.
LLM proposal followed by hard validation
Retained as an optional interface. The deterministic engine owns time, legality, resources and transactions.
The operational layer is substantially different from version 1

Version 1 stored unknown coefficients as null and was not an executable specification. Version 2 supplies complete demonstration values, declarative predicates and a reference evaluator, while preserving the uncalibrated status. Missing host inputs still fail closed. The JSON can be loaded directly by the included kernel; it cannot add absent physics to an existing HTML simply by being imported.

Cells make autonomous decisions, but their outcomes are not statistically independent. They share fields, contact constraints and resource competition. Daughters can share a lineage component in their clocks. Mouse organoid live imaging supports correlated sister behavior and therefore argues against independent redraws of every daughter from an unrelated population. The human magnitude remains unestimated. [R11]
Source audit: numerical and algorithmic claims

The second playbook assigns strong evidence tiers to many generic numbers and then asks readers to recheck those parameters. They are not imported as measured human constants. The table records the main reconciliation decisions so that changes are visible rather than silently replacing the source. [S02, sections 2, 4, 6 and 15]
A 100 agent unit represents cells at 1:50 scale
Rejected for this task. Each agent represents one individual cell; omitted tissue contributes only through declared boundaries.
One softmax choice per cell per minute
Replaced by competing initiation hazards within channels. Separate secretion and motility channels can operate together.
Generic cytokine half lives and 50 to 100 µm ranges are tier A
Downgraded to explicit transport priors unless a matched experiment estimates them. The registry does not claim a measured CXCL8 range.
Exponential profile around any point source
Restricted to the appropriate geometry. A point source in two dimensions differs from a planar source and from a point source in three dimensions.
Every new cell cycle is followed by another full cycle refractory period
Rejected as double counting. The full cycle event already accounts for cycle time.
A fixed apoptosis latency is a universal biological limit
Rejected. Separate prior state, stimulus exposure, commitment, execution and disposal; timestamp each observation.
A fixed temperature makes healthy or inflamed tissue look right
Not used as biological calibration. Stochasticity is parameterized through hazards, inherited variation and explicit uncertainty.
A fixed 2D to 3D neighbor multiplier repairs geometry
Rejected. Contact area, topology and section uncertainty must be estimated or varied explicitly.
A hard computational bound is not automatically a hard biological bound

The kernel enforces the declared duration support for a particular versioned demonstration. That prevents an untracked override from turning a full cycle into two minutes. It does not assert that the lower support is the shortest cycle possible in every human tissue. Revising a prior requires a new parameter version and sensitivity analysis, not a hidden exception in an animation handler.
Source audit: biological and causal claims
Paneth contact determines symmetric versus asymmetric division
Rejected as a deterministic switch. Niche context and lineage history constrain daughter outcomes; contact is not a complete fate oracle. [R08, R10, R11]
IL22 increases progenitor proliferation by a universal 20 percent
Removed. Regenerative and stem expansion restricting effects occur in different organoid contexts. No universal multiplier is supplied. [R12, R13]
Mouse epithelial NAIP/NLRC4 rules are the human default
Separated into species and cell specific overlays. Human epithelial CASP4 evidence is distinct from human macrophage and mouse epithelial findings. [R22, R23, R27]
Gasdermin pore formation is necessarily terminal death
Separated from terminal membrane failure. Membrane repair downstream of gasdermin activation has experimental support. [R24]
Resident macrophages constitutively secrete IL10 by definition
Removed. Human resident macrophage phagocytosis does not require large inflammatory output, but identity does not guarantee any one cytokine output. [R17]
Treg CTLA4 acts on CTLA4 in the opposing APC
Corrected to CTLA4 on the regulatory cell and CD80/CD86 on the opposing cell. [R26]
Every mildly stressed epithelial cell is an NK or IEL target
Removed. Recognition and inhibitory context are explicit host contracts; stress alone is not sufficient.
IgG associated spatial modules guarantee failure of TNF blockade
Removed. Patient association is not a rule that predetermines an intervention outcome. [R03, R05]
Inflammatory fibroblasts must sustain their own IL1B indefinitely
Not assumed. Candidate stromal amplification requires competent outputs, finite resources, memory and measured feedback. [R05, R18]

The implementation also keeps DUOX2 as an intracellular or membrane associated epithelial program rather than a freely secreted cytokine. The human Paneth marker panel uses DEFA5, DEFA6 and LYZ. A mouse Reg3g program is not silently relabeled as a measured human protein output. Basal secretion may continue as a rate, while bursts deplete stores. These distinctions preserve the terminology and limits of the source contexts. [S01, S02; R01, R02]

Evidence is attached to a claim, not to an entire paper or cell type. A single rule can combine an experimentally supported mechanism, an atlas supported recipient identity, a cross species transfer and a proposed numerical coefficient.
A mechanism or timing observation measured in the cited experimental system.
A universal human threshold, rate or duration outside that system.
A measured cell state, abundance association or spatial relationship.
Direction of causality, active secretion, receptor engagement or event timing.
A transfer between species, anatomical regions, assays, tissue depths or perturbation contexts.
Equivalence of the source and target systems.
An explicit implementation choice or numerical prior.
An experimentally fitted or validated biological value.
Every number needs a defined role

Record whether a number is an observation time, a lower detection limit, a fitted event duration, a rate constant, a normalized threshold, a solver tolerance or a display parameter. A sample collected after eight hours is not an eight hour execution timer. A positivity condition for a numerical diffusion solver is not a biological refractory period. A score threshold chosen for a demonstration must remain P even when the scored pathway is well established.

The JSON records value, units, evidence label, calibration status, rationale, sensitivity range and source context. It explicitly sets source_supplies_value to false for the distributed values. Duration records additionally define the clock origin, distribution, lower support, mode, upper support and whether the support is a biological bound. Here it is not. Action records distinguish source references for associations from references for mechanistic context.

A future fitted rule should record organism, tissue region, disease state, treatment context, assay, sampling interval, donor count, endpoint and exclusion criteria. A mouse crypt measurement transferred to adult human ileum needs a T label even when its direction is credible. A colonic IBD spatial neighborhood does not become an ileal neighborhood merely because both contain macrophages.

The reference register states which sources were inspected in this consolidation and which were retained from version 1. Existing accession identifiers are preserved as retrieval targets, not described as data downloaded or fitted here. A final methods manuscript should verify each used accession, sample subset, license and parameter against the exact data version actually analyzed.
Human datasets: identity and spatial organization

The data integration plan separates three tasks: identify cells, locate cells, and estimate dynamics. Dissociated RNA is useful for state annotation. Spatial RNA and targeted protein imaging constrain neighborhood and phenotype. Neither alone supplies every transition rate.
Elmentaite et al. [R01]. E MTAB accessions 9543, 9536, 9532, 9533 and 10386.
Choose adult ileal identities and regional programs.
Do not pool developmental ages and regions as one baseline. Exact accession strings are retained in the data manifest.
Hickey et al. [R02]. HuBMAP HBM692.JRZB.356; Dryad 10.5061/dryad.pk0p2ngrf.
Constrain anatomical organization, contacts and targeted protein phenotypes.
CODEX is a targeted panel, not a complete spatial proteome.
Li et al. [R06]. GSE312415 and GSE312420; Figshare 10.6084/m9.figshare.31595527.
IBD spatial assay comparison and candidate RNA and protein integration.
Check panel coverage, matched sample identity, platform differences and controlled access conditions.
Initialization is a joint sample, not a bag of cell labels

Select a donor and anatomical field before assigning cell states. Preserve local epithelial geometry, stromal positions, vascular interfaces and nearby immune populations. A synthetic mixture assembled independently from many unrelated donors is useful for software testing, but it should not be labeled a real patient microdomain. The supplied 100 cell presets are synthetic for precisely this reason.

Sparse receptor RNA does not establish surface receptor absence, and RNA abundance does not directly measure ligand secretion. A two dimensional section can miss contacts above or below the plane. A mixed spatial spot is not an individual agent until a justified deconvolution or segmentation model assigns it. Keep uncertain receptor competence and uncertain spatial adjacency separate from confirmed negatives.
Protein data do not remove all uncertainty

A targeted antibody panel only supports the measured proteins, under its detection and segmentation model. Total protein and active protein are different observations. Phosphorylation, cleavage, pore formation, secretion and membrane accessibility may require different assays. Do not use the presence of CASP3 protein as a timestamp for completed apoptosis. These safeguards apply before scores enter the decision engine. [R02, R06]
Human datasets: IBD states and perturbation context
Ileal Crohn associated inflammatory myeloid, T cell, stromal and IgG plasma cell states.
A deterministic anti TNF failure rule or a universal Crohn state present in every lesion.
Garrido Trigo et al. [R04], GSE214695, GSE235236 and GSE234713.
Colonic IBD single cell RNA, bulk RNA and spatial myeloid context.
Measured human ileal recruitment or death rates; transfer from colon remains explicit.
Kong et al. [R05], SCP2959, phs003943.v1.p1 and Zenodo 14509802.
Stricturing Crohn associated cell networks, spatial context and preexisting matrix state.
Time from one cytokine pulse to clinical stenosis, or whole wall mechanics from a mucosal patch.
Mouse organoid lineage and cell cycle trajectories for dynamic model development.
A human cycle distribution or complete in vivo intestinal mechanics.
Bulk data have a separate role

Use bulk time courses to constrain aggregate response direction and timing after accounting for changing cell composition. An increase in CXCL8 RNA could reflect stronger expression in an existing population, recruitment of another population, or both. A simulation should expose those mechanisms separately so that fitting does not convert a composition shift into a universal intracellular activation rule.
Disease initialization and disease emergence are different tests

A Crohn associated preset can begin with inflammatory cell states and preexisting tissue damage. That tests how a network behaves from a patient associated condition. It does not demonstrate that the model explains disease initiation. Conversely, an acute injury simulation should not be forced to assemble the same module on a prescribed schedule. Chronic persistence is an outcome to examine, not a condition inserted into every feedback loop. [R03, R05]

For each selected field, export deidentified donor and sample keys, assay identity, anatomical site, disease and treatment metadata, cell coordinates, segmentation quality, type probabilities, measured markers, derived program scores and uncertainty. Save the observation model used to compare these data with simulated agents. No patient identifier is needed in a per cell decision request.
Geometry, individual agents and boundary accounting

The default anatomy is ileum because the intended architecture includes a crypt associated niche, a villus facing epithelial surface and Paneth cells. Colon requires different geometry and regional cell states. Microvilli are structures on individual epithelial cells, not extra cell agents. Store microvillus function as a property contributing to absorption. [R01, R02]
A reduced microdomain, not a complete crypt and villus

One hundred individual agents do not reconstruct an entire anatomically scaled crypt plus villus with all supporting cells. The explicit domain is a cropped microdomain embedded in a declared environment. Unmodeled tissue can contribute prescribed niche support, mechanical boundary conditions, luminal exposure, vascular availability or lymphatic exit. It must not secretly act as an additional population whose outputs appear without accounting.
Physical and screen coordinates are different

The registry uses micrometers and minutes. The demonstration patch dimensions, grid spacing, effective thickness and contact distance are P. The renderer may stretch or magnify the drawing without changing physical distance. A cell drawn 30 pixels away cannot sense a ligand earlier because the camera zoomed. A contact graph should be derived from geometry and accessible surfaces rather than from centroid distance alone.

The host supplies an oriented epithelial surface, apical and basal compartments, a basement membrane or support interface, lamina propria space, a vascular interface and reachable paths. A contact includes cell identity, contact area or length, membrane side, duration and uncertainty. Local crowding and tension can affect behavior only through modeled mechanical cues; cells do not count hidden cell labels in an arbitrary radius.
N_living(next) = N_living + net births + entries − deaths − living exits
N_present(next) = N_present + net births + entries − all exits − clearances

Death changes viability but may leave a corpse present. Engulfment or shedding changes presence later. A successful division normally creates one net additional living cell from one parent, while accounting for inherited material and growth. A vascular entry must be counted once even if several frames show the cell crossing.
What happens when the interface displays exactly 100 cells

Use a moving observation window or a display selection from a larger simulated population. Do not delete an unrelated cell whenever another divides. Display limits are not biological homeostatic mechanisms.
The 100 cell presets and state representation
Stem, transit amplifying and Paneth cells
Trophocytes, other fibroblasts and BMP stroma
Resident macrophages, inflammatory monocytes and neutrophils
Dendritic cells, Th17, Th1 and Tregs
CD8 IELs, NK cells and ILC3

Every count above is P. These are deliberately constructed test mixtures, not fractions estimated from an atlas. The healthy preset contains previously primed tissue lymphocytes; it does not require all T cells to arrive after time zero. Optional specialized populations have no forced minimum representation. Pericytes in these presets are support placeholders unless their physical module is enabled.

Separate stable broad lineage from subtype, inflammatory program, stress, repair, cycle phase and output competence. The state record stores viability, resources, secretory stores, intracellular cargo, receptor competence, exposure memory, active events, lineage history and uncertainty. A strong interferon response should not overwrite enterocyte identity. A phagocytic macrophage need not be assigned a strongly inflammatory state. [R04, R17]

Do not make every agent newly born, recently activated and fully stocked. Initialize age and partial cycle progress from a declared model. A previously started event needs its historical full duration and elapsed active time. An old epithelial cell can finish a cycle or shedding event soon after simulation start without having completed the entire process in that short interval. The example snapshot is a synthetic unit test input, not a measured cell.

Contact signals require accessible physical contact. Soluble signals require transport to the receptor bearing surface. Intracellular sensing requires compatible material or activity inside the cell. These are not interchangeable. A luminal pathogen field does not automatically activate a cytosolic sensor, and a soluble cytokine cannot substitute for a required immune synapse.
Niche support is not one freely diffusing Wnt field

Mouse work supports a contact associated Wnt3 component in the crypt niche. Stromal populations can contribute other forms of support and BMP related context. The final model therefore distinguishes local membrane associated support, soluble or boundary supplied support and the physical niche. It does not infer symmetric daughter fate merely from the presence of one Paneth neighbor. [R08, R09, R10, R25]
The cell does not receive an omniscient neighborhood summary

The host may compute neighborhood descriptors for analysis, but only physically sensed components can influence decisions. A cell cannot know that there are exactly three infected cells 100 µm away unless a modeled route conveys information. The kernel accepts local receptor activities, direct contact information and mechanical cues. It does not accept pathogen coordinates as a chemotactic instruction.
Receptor competence is an explicit input

Competence includes accessible receptor, necessary partners, downstream machinery and uncertainty. Candidate receptor programs in the cell dictionary are annotation guides, not mandatory expression in every cell. RNA dropout should be handled at initialization by a documented prior or by keeping the route unlicensed. It should not be silently converted into confirmed absence. Functional evidence can override an uncertain RNA measurement, but the provenance should show that decision.
Apical and basal fields remain distinct

Every secretion event identifies a release compartment. Paneth antimicrobial cargo and goblet mucus enter a luminal or apical compartment. Epithelial chemokine output used for myeloid recruitment enters the accessible basal environment. Antibody transport requires substrate and a transport interface. An intact epithelial sheet may strongly restrict some species while allowing other transport mechanisms; one universal impermeable wall for all signals is also an approximation.
Mechanistic locality replaces a fixed detection radius

Local concentration and gradient depend on production, diffusion, binding, uptake, clearance and boundaries. The 50 µm context radius in the registry is only an observational summary scale. It is not an experimentally established radius beyond which a cytokine becomes invisible.

The decision engine checks legality before scoring. Every action is limited by lineage, current state, physical access, resources, relevant competence and the availability of the host module that executes its effect. A high score cannot compensate for a failed requirement.

The JSON uses all and any combinations of simple predicates. Each atomic predicate names a path, an operator and either a literal value or a parameter reference. Supported operators are eq, in, gte, gt, lte and lt. The evaluator does not execute arbitrary strings. Unsafe object paths and unsupported operators are rejected.

This condition compares an available store with a versioned demonstration threshold. It does not mean that every real goblet cell has the same biological threshold. The reference value, 0.1 normalized store units, is P. Resource reservation subsequently prevents two simultaneous actions from spending the same material.

A missing gate input denies the action. A missing or nonfinite score feature is an explicit error rather than an assumed zero. A missing host capability produces a diagnostic rejection reason. For example, a macrophage cannot engulf a corpse without the targets and phagocytosis capabilities, verified contact, an available target identifier and sufficient capacity. Rejection logs expose missing biology and missing software separately.
Initiation gates and continuation gates are not identical

Initiation can require an unreserved target, a ready cycle or an available vascular slot. Once the event starts, it owns the reservation. Continuation must not cancel merely because that same target is now reserved by the event itself. The final registry removes those initiation only checks from the continuation predicate but retains contact, support and other sustained requirements. Other events still see the resource or target as unavailable.
The engine enforces a declared model, not all conceivable biology

Mature enterocytes cannot divide in the default model. An optional repair state does not automatically bypass that restriction. Adding injury induced reprogramming requires a new lineage contract, appropriate evidence and a tested transition. Similarly, a named cell type does not authorize every cytokine output listed somewhere in the literature. Competence remains specific to the initialized state and experimental scope.
Scores, hazards and the meaning of a decision

A transcriptomic program score summarizes a measurement. It is not a probability and has no intrinsic unit of events per minute. The proposed engine uses such scores as candidate covariates in a separately calibrated event model.

The gate g is either zero or one. The score z is dimensionless. The baseline h0 has units per minute and bounds this particular logistic hazard. Positive weights increase propensity in the stated context; negative weights decrease it. A different link function or interaction structure is permissible after model comparison. The logistic form and all distributed coefficients are P, not formulas recovered from an IBD atlas.
A worked calculation from the demonstration settings

Consider an eligible action with intercept −2, one positively weighted feature equal to 0.8 and weight 2. The score is −0.4. Its sigmoid is approximately 0.4013. With baseline hazard 0.03 per minute, the resulting initiation hazard is approximately 0.01204 per minute. In one minute the event probability is about 0.01197, not 0.4013. The larger number is the link value, not the probability of an action during an arbitrary tick.
Why a fixed per tick probability is wrong

If a programmer gives a cell a 10 percent chance to act every frame, speeding up the renderer changes biological behavior. A rate with physical time units avoids that error. Constant hazard over a short interval is still an approximation when inputs change rapidly. Refine the biological step or integrate a time varying hazard when a coarse interval would miss the response dynamics.

The model needs an intercept, coefficient magnitudes, a hazard scale, the allowed feature range and any interactions. A sign supported by a perturbation does not identify the magnitude. A receptor threshold fitted in arbitrary normalized units cannot be interpreted as an EC50 in molar units. Donor and lineage effects should be fitted or explicitly sampled rather than hidden inside a global noise parameter.

These event propensities are for local simulated actions. They are not probabilities of Crohn progression, remission or response to a treatment. Such outcomes require separate definitions, cohorts and validation.

Some actions compete for one state transition. Other processes can coexist. The model uses separate channels for viability, cycle, lineage, movement, contact regulation, cargo processing and mediator specific induction. Locks and shared resources resolve incompatibilities between channels.
P(any event in Δt) = 1 − exp(−H × Δt)
P(action a | an event) = h(a) / H

For two eligible hazards of 0.02 and 0.01 per minute, H is 0.03. In one minute, the chance of either event is approximately 0.02955. Conditional on an event, the first action is selected with probability two thirds. Over 30 minutes with truly constant hazards, the chance of at least one initiation is approximately 0.59343. These are arithmetic examples, P, not biological estimates.
Sample a waiting time rather than forcing activity

The reference kernel draws a waiting time from an exponential distribution with rate H. If it falls outside the decision interval, nothing starts. Otherwise it selects an action in proportion to its hazard. This provides a natural null outcome. There is no need to assign a large arbitrary softmax weight to doing nothing merely to prevent every cell from acting each minute.

A monocyte may induce CCL2 while migrating. Two induction programs may compete for the same synthesis budget. A cytotoxic contact can lock motility. A lineage commitment and cycle event share locks. A completed terminal death transition cancels incompatible work. The kernel evaluates candidates from a shared snapshot and rechecks permissions when reservations are acquired; it does not assume that every initially legal proposal can start.
Do not make a race out of iteration order

The host should collect proposals from the same tissue snapshot, sort by proposed event time and resolve exact ties reproducibly. It should not let the first cell in an array secrete a mediator that instantly triggers the last cell during the same sensing pass. A stable cell ordering and seed policy aid reproducibility, but structural checks for order dependence are still necessary.
Completion is not another decision lottery

Once a full cycle has run and the physical completion requirements are satisfied, the model does not ask the cell to win a second division lottery. Completion remains pending if the host cannot accommodate daughters. That is a physical transaction problem, not a reason to redraw the full cycle.

A cell can respond differently to a brief pulse and a sustained exposure even when the current concentration is the same. The model therefore stores a normalized memory of accessible receptor activity, rather than only the latest field value.

The final expression is exact for constant activity during the interval. The default n is one, not an assumed universal Hill coefficient of two. K is a concentration scale only in the chosen normalized units. It becomes a physical affinity or response constant only when the underlying model and measurements justify that interpretation.

With activity one, initial memory zero and τ equal to 60 minutes, memory is approximately 0.3935 after 30 minutes and 0.6321 after 60 minutes. When activity returns to zero, the stored memory decays exponentially. These P settings permit a sustained exposure gate without inventing a minimum human cytokine exposure from a single RNA snapshot.

Use distinct activation and deactivation conditions when supported, or let induced output capacity decay over time. The registry prevents an already high output capacity from being repeatedly induced every tick. Induction may resume after capacity declines and the relevant refractory and exposure requirements are met. A fibroblast does not remain inflammatory forever simply because that makes a chronic animation look convincing.
State variables must describe different processes

Keep receptor activity, pathway state, exposure memory, transcriptional capacity, stored protein and extracellular mediator separate. A declining extracellular concentration need not immediately erase an induced program. Conversely, an activated transcriptomic program does not create an unlimited protein store. Receptor desensitization and negative feedback require additional states when included; they are not implied by using a sigmoid.

The exactMemory and receptorActivity functions implement these arithmetic contracts with finite input checks. They do not estimate receptor density or infer competence from RNA. The host supplies normalized activities with provenance. Changing the memory time constant or the score normalization must be part of the parameter version because either change alters initiation behavior.
Event clocks, phase history and duration distributions

Every event has an origin, a sampled duration, elapsed active time, a continuation policy and a completion record. The same duration is retained when the cell is redrawn on screen or a model provider is queried again. Pausing preserves progress; cancellation releases reservations and records a reason.
The triangular distribution is an engineering prior

Each duration is described by lower support a, mode m and upper support b, in minutes. Its mean is (a + m + b) / 3. The supports are not confidence intervals or measured biological limits. They expose the range used by this demonstration and can be replaced by empirical, lognormal, gamma or survival models when data identify those distributions.
For u < (m − a)/(b − a): T = a + √[u(b − a)(m − a)]
Otherwise: T = b − √[(1 − u)(b − a)(b − m)]

The full stem cycle prior is 1080, 1440 and 2160 minutes. Its mean is 1560 minutes, or 26 hours. The mode is 24 hours, not the mean. The transit amplifying prior is 720, 1080 and 1800 minutes, whose mean is 20 hours. Neither distribution was fitted to human ileum. The mouse organoid mean of 16.2 hours is a distinct observation. [R11]
Initial age is not a fresh duration draw

For an event already underway, supply its historical full duration and elapsed active time. The remaining time is full duration minus elapsed active time, conditional on that event still being active. In an ideal stationary renewal process sampled at a random time, longer intervals are overrepresented. A length weighted interval distribution followed by a conditional age draw is more appropriate than assigning every cell a new interval. An expanding lineage or migrating tissue needs its own age model; stationary renewal assumptions are not universal.

The default cell cycle can pause when niche or checkpoint requirements fail. It can be cancelled by terminal death. Entry into S phase is not represented as a guarantee that mitosis must finish regardless of DNA damage. Differentiation locks restrict concurrent default choices, but functional maturation still takes time and needs support. Optional reprogramming is a separate model extension, not a reversal generated by a language model.

A cell with 1439 minutes already completed in a recorded 1440 minute cycle may finish after one simulated minute. A newly initiated cell may not complete that same full cycle in one minute. The tests distinguish these cases explicitly.

The mediator environment is a mass balance problem. The source papers motivate particular senders, receivers and contexts. They do not supply a single measured diffusion coefficient or half life for every cytokine in human ileal tissue. The final transport values are therefore P.
∂c/∂t = D∇²c − ∇·(v c) − k c − U(c) + Q

D is an effective diffusion coefficient, v a transport velocity, k a first order loss rate, U uptake and Q sources. Binding to matrix or cell surfaces may require additional free and bound states. A membrane ligand belongs on a contact graph rather than in this soluble equation unless a shed form is explicitly modeled.

With the demonstration D of 100 µm² per minute and half life of 30 minutes, k is approximately 0.02310 per minute and λ approximately 65.79 µm. In two dimensions the mean squared displacement timescale over 50 µm is 6.25 minutes. These numbers illustrate dimensional consistency. They are not a measured CXCL8 travel time or a sharply bounded detection radius.

For a homogeneous medium with first order loss, a one dimensional steady profile away from a planar source has an exponential dependence on distance. A three dimensional point source additionally has a 1/r geometric factor. A two dimensional point source involves a modified Bessel function. Thus a single exponential around every source in any mesh is not a universal solution. Near source regularization, boundaries and finite cell dimensions also matter.
A diffusion equation has no strict arrival front

Ideal diffusion has a mathematically nonzero tail at arbitrarily short times. Biological detectability depends on concentration, receptor response, noise and integration. The model should therefore enforce concentration dependent sensing and exposure history, not interpret λ as a hard sensing cutoff or report the first infinitesimal tail as a meaningful cellular response.
Uniform grid helper versus full tissue solver

The supplied helper covers diffusion and first order decay on an equal volume two dimensional grid with closed outer boundaries. It does not implement epithelial permeability, matrix binding, blood perfusion or directed luminal flow. Actions needing those processes require corresponding host capabilities.
Units, field stability and compartment interfaces
Amounts and concentrations cannot be mixed

A source releases an amount per time. The field stores concentration. Depositing source amount into a grid voxel therefore requires its volume or the declared effective volume of a two dimensional section. For a grid with 10 µm spacing and 10 µm thickness, the effective voxel volume is 1000 µm³, equal to one picoliter. As a dimensional illustration, 600 molecules in that volume correspond to approximately 0.996 nM. These geometric choices are P, not a measured epithelial extracellular volume.
amount added per update = secretion rate × elapsed time

For explicit diffusion on a rectangular two dimensional grid, a sufficient positivity condition is D Δt (2/Δx² + 2/Δy²) ≤ 1. The reference helper uses substeps with a factor no greater than 0.9 and applies first order decay exponentially. With D equal to 100 µm² per minute, 10 µm spacing and a one minute biological interval, one explicit field step is too large. The helper subdivides it. A display frame never sets the physical diffusion coefficient.

A stable calculation can still be inaccurate. Compare field resolution, diffusion substeps and biological decision intervals separately. Confirm nonnegative values and the expected total mass balance under closed boundaries, sources, uptake and decay. Do not silently clip large negative concentrations to zero, since that can hide an unstable solver and introduce mass errors.
interface transfer = permeability × area × (c_left − c_right) × Δt

This interface relation is a proposed linear permeability model, not a universal epithelial transport law. Transfer must be bounded by donor availability and recorded on both sides. Active transport, saturable uptake or selective barriers may require other laws. A barrier threshold such as 0.7 should not instantaneously open every molecular route unless it is an explicit, tested engineering approximation.

A short apparent spatial range can arise from slow diffusion, rapid decay, uptake, binding or geometry. A static profile alone may identify a combined length scale without uniquely identifying each component. Fit multiple measurements or retain multiple parameter sets. Identical rendered gradients can conceal different biological transport models.
The runnable profile uses normalized concentrations and amounts. Do not label them pg/mL or nM in the interface until source rates, volume, uptake and loss are consistently calibrated.
Resources, action effects and atomic transactions

Each action reserves the material it needs before it starts. Reservations reduce availability to other actions but do not immediately remove total inventory. Successful completion consumes the reservation and applies the corresponding effect once. Cancellation releases the reservation. A failed physical transaction leaves all changes pending.

A goblet release can reserve 0.1 normalized granule units and 0.02 normalized energy units. On successful completion, the host emits exactly the reserved store amount into the declared apical compartment and consumes that amount from the store. The final registry does not multiply the emitted amount by another fraction while consuming the entire reservation. Repeated updates cannot emit the same packet twice.
New synthesis is different from stored release

Induction changes an output capacity after its clock. Continuous secretion then consumes a declared synthesis substrate at a finite rate. Store replenishment requires material supply and time. A basal flux is allowed without repeatedly starting a new induction event. The reference boundedFlux function computes the lesser of the requested amount and available substrate. It does not invent substrate or infer a physical protein production rate.

Engulfment requires one owner of a particular accessible target. A second macrophage cannot consume the same corpse while the first event is underway. Contact loss can cancel the event and release the target. A successful engulfment retires the extracellular target and creates appropriate intracellular cargo. Processing and microbial killing remain distinct; ingestion is not proof of sterilization. [R17]

The kernel returns a completion plan containing state assignments, reserved costs and typed physical intents. The host checks geometry, target ownership, destination access and resource totals, then applies the entire plan atomically. An acknowledgment includes the transaction identifier, application time and advanced tissue revision. Without that receipt, effects remain pending. Repeated acknowledgment does not duplicate the event.
Mass and capacity have different meanings

A phagocytic capacity variable represents an operational occupancy budget, not grams of matter. Its debit must still be matched to intracellular cargo and later restoration. Cell mass, antibody amount and extracellular mediator amount need their own ledgers if they are modeled. Do not claim molecular mass conservation from a test of normalized capacity arithmetic.
Death and cleanup are separate transactions

Terminal death cancels incompatible ongoing work. A dead cell may remain present until extrusion or clearance. Disappearance, release of intracellular cargo and changes in barrier function depend on the selected physical event, not on a generic deletion command.
Measured timing anchors and what they support
Paneth antimicrobial release within minutes in mouse crypt preparations. [R07]
A rapid action can release existing cargo.
New synthesis and packaging are completed within the same interval; exact human delay is known.
STAT3 assessed after a 20 minute IL22 pulse. [R12]
A pathway readout can be measured on a short timescale.
An entire epithelial cell cycle or organoid regeneration takes 20 minutes.
Human organoid growth assessed on day 6. [R12]
A later tissue growth endpoint can constrain a growth model.
Every response must wait exactly six days to start.
Mean full cell cycle of 16.2 hours in mouse intestinal organoids. [R11]
A quantitative dynamic anchor exists in that experimental system.
Every human stem cell or progenitor has the same cycle.
Human neutrophil and organoid extrusion readouts at an eight hour endpoint. [R16]
A context specific immune contribution to epithelial extrusion can be modeled and tested.
Eight hours is a universal delay from receptor activation to extrusion.
Junctional remodeling during mouse epithelial shedding. [R15]
Extrusion can be coordinated with neighboring barrier rearrangement.
All shedding leaves a persistent gap, or a universal event duration was fitted here.
Observation windows should remain in the observation model

An experiment may measure cytokine at six hours and image extrusion every few minutes. Fit the simulated measurements at those same observation times. Do not assign the sampling interval as the duration of each hidden cellular event. Multiple initiations can contribute to one endpoint, and an observed completed event may have begun before the imaging window.
Use primary kinetics when a specific action matters

If the main scientific question concerns apoptosis timing, a general epithelial atlas is insufficient. Select a matched dynamic experiment with an active death readout, the relevant stimulus, an explicit time origin and measurable execution or disposal. The same requirement applies to neutrophil transit, goblet replenishment and fibroblast state reversal. No universal hard time table is claimed in this version.
