Stem cells and transit amplifying progenitors

Use a crypt associated identity supported by a panel such as LGR5, OLFM4 and ASCL2, not by one mandatory detected transcript. Niche position and local support matter. Mouse niche and lineage experiments inform the mechanism; human atlases define regional identity. [R01, R08, R09, R10, R11]

The default renewal event requires viable identity, resources, a ready cycle, sufficient niche support and passed checkpoints. Its score increases with niche support and decreases with damage. ISC_CYCLE includes the full sampled cycle; the host must accommodate daughters and account for their inherited state and material. The same progenitor can instead enter a licensed lineage maturation event, with shared locks preventing simultaneous division and differentiation.

Paneth contact does not assign symmetric division deterministically. Daughters inherit a recorded lineage context; additional stochasticity is explicit. A short IL22 response does not automatically accelerate this cycle. Loss of support may pause progress rather than delete the cell. Validate completed divisions and lineage retention, not only LGR5 expression. [R12, R13]

Identify the proliferative epithelial compartment from molecular state and physical location. The annotation does not timestamp the next mitosis. Human state data and mouse cycle trajectories support different parts of this definition. [R01, R02, R11]

TA_CYCLE requires a ready cycle, checkpoints, resources and a finite renewal policy. The demonstration maximum of five completed rounds is P, not a universal lineage law. Absorptive, goblet associated and Paneth associated maturation are separate outcomes, permitted only when the host provides target specific lineage competence and niche context. Contact dependent Notch input changes a candidate score; it does not solve every epithelial fate choice. [R20]

The cell cannot proliferate, complete differentiation and acquire a full mature granule pool in one update. Compare lineage output, completed cycle intervals, spatial confinement and maturation markers. Injury induced reentry from a mature state requires an additional contract rather than changing the type label to gain a division licence.

Use an absorptive epithelial program with regional markers such as ALPI, FABP1 and APOA4. Store apical orientation, basal support, junctional contacts and a microvillus function property. Atlas identity and spatial organization do not measure an individual death or secretion hazard. [R01, R02]

The default cell maintains absorption and barrier contribution through host continuous functions. Accessible alarm exposure can initiate CXCL8 output capacity after a synthesis clock. TNF responsive junction remodeling, IL22 associated defence induction, reversible recovery and wound edge restitution are distinct actions. Each needs its own competence and host capability. There is no direct instruction to recruit a neutrophil or to die simply because TNF is high.

LIVE_EXTRUSION coordinates a viable epithelial cell and its neighbors. Death commitment and execution are separate. The mature enterocyte cannot divide in this default model. Validate coverage, junction continuity, permeability and loss or recovery of absorptive function, not only a transcript score. Reduced brush border function should not instantly delete the whole cell. [R15, R16]

Use a secretory epithelial identity, including MUC2 in an appropriate marker panel. A low transcript measurement is not a direct measure of an empty protein store, and neither establishes that the cell has died. [R01, R02]

GOBLET_RELEASE requires a competent local stimulus, luminal surface access, resources and a nonempty granule store. It reserves a finite cargo amount and releases it once through the host transaction. Basal mucus supply, bursts, replenishment and the resulting mucus material layer are separate functions. The exact refill time and stimulus threshold remain proposed rather than inferred from the atlas.

Neighbor loss may permit restitution without division. A mature goblet cell does not become an enterocyte merely because the renderer needs a replacement. Quantify stored cargo, emitted mucus, local access of luminal material and cell survival independently. The scalar mucus field in the demonstration is not a measured rheological mucus model.
Paneth cells and repair associated epithelium

Use human DEFA5, DEFA6 and LYZ as part of a contextual Paneth identity panel. Position the cell in a compatible crypt niche. Mouse preparations support rapid stored antimicrobial release, while niche studies support a separate local support function. [R01, R07, R08, R09]

PANETH_RELEASE reserves existing cargo and directs it to the apical compartment. Empty stores reduce release capacity but do not imply cell death. Niche support is maintained through a separate bounded host process, with a contact associated Wnt3 component where appropriate. Antimicrobial release and stem support must not be multiplied together into one all purpose Paneth health score.

Long residence does not make the cell immune to injury. The default does not let a Paneth cell divide or chemotax through the lamina propria. A genotype or autophagy hypothesis may alter a specified capability, but not every Crohn run receives a fixed Paneth defect. Validate local release, store depletion, survival and recipient niche effects separately.

This optional entry records a proposed injury associated state, not proof that any CLU positive cell is a functional stem cell. Its origin, lineage history and renewal competence require experimental definition. The supplied sources motivate epithelial plasticity as an extension but do not fit its rate here. [S01, S02; R01, R10]

Keep the cell within its epithelial lineage. It may receive supported repair, alarm, barrier and viability actions if the corresponding modules are enabled. Default proliferative licences are not granted merely by assigning a repair label. A future reprogramming action should specify an eligible origin, a commitment assay, a maturation interval, a destination niche and observed functional renewal.

This conservative handling prevents a large wound from being repaired by instantaneous identity changes. First test closure by surviving cell movement and geometry. Then test whether a separately supported regenerative population is needed. The inability of an unimplemented extension to close a wound is a model limitation, not proof that the omitted mechanism is indispensable in all tissues.
Crypt niche and BMP producing stromal cells

A human niche supporting state can be initialized from spatial and molecular evidence. The GREM1, RSPO3 and CD81 panel is a candidate annotation, informed partly by mouse mesenchymal experiments. It is not a guaranteed one to one translation of every atlas subtype. [R02, R25]

The cell provides explicitly modeled support to nearby progenitors or to a declared niche field. Contact topology and soluble access determine recipients. Inflammatory activation is a separate program requiring competence and sustained cues. Conversion does not instantly erase all niche output unless a measured mechanism or a clearly labeled scenario specifies that loss.

The demonstration does not infer that crypt failure must occur exactly one or two days after this cell is lost. Fit recipient cycle and survival consequences to a matched perturbation. Record which support is generated by explicit cells and which is supplied at the boundary, so compensation is visible rather than hidden.

Use a location appropriate stromal identity with support for BMP related output. Mouse work distinguishes niche supportive mesenchyme from other BMP associated sources, but a colonic S2 label should not automatically be treated as a human villus tip telocyte. [R02, R25]

The host supplies the physical source location and a ligand specific output process. Recipient BMP activity can reduce renewal propensity in an eligible progenitor while contributing to positional differentiation context. The action dictionary keeps inflammatory and matrix programs available only when the state is competent. A fixed function of normalized height is a P boundary approximation, not a measured cellular secretion law.

Validate the spatial relationship between source cells, recipient pathway activity and proliferation. Do not use high BMP as a command that every mature cell at the top of the drawing must die immediately. The source geometry and renewal consequences need separate tests. [R21]

Keep niche support, inflammatory output, matrix production and contractile behavior as separable programs. Spatial IBD and stricturing data support heterogeneous stromal states; OSM work supplies an experimental inflammatory circuit. [R02, R05, R18]

STROMAL_ACTIVATION requires competent inflammatory signaling and sustained memory. Its score can include local OSM, active IL1B and TNF inputs. Mediator specific induction then creates bounded CXCL8, CCL2 or IL6 output capacity where licensed. The cell is not assumed to produce mature IL1B or to become permanently inflammatory after one pulse.

MATRIX_REMODELING is disabled until matrix and mechanics modules exist. Active signaling, substrate supply, deposition, degradation and stiffness are distinct variables. A collagen transcript increase is not instant fibrosis. Short simulations should initialize preexisting matrix rather than claim to generate an intestinal stricture from one local episode. [R05]

Place the agent on a connected vascular interface with distinct blood and tissue sides. The four explicit endothelial cells represent a local interface, not a complete perfused vessel. A macrophage TNF, endothelial TNFR2 and ICAM1 circuit supports spatial recruitment permission in its experimental contexts. [R19]

ENDOTHELIAL_ACTIVATION creates an adhesion competent state after a proposed induction clock. VASCULAR_CROSSING belongs to an existing reservoir leukocyte and requires verified adhesion, a reachable route and an available crossing slot. The cell cannot appear at the chemokine source. Homeostatic trafficking may use a preexisting permissive interface rather than requiring a new inflammatory pulse for every entry.

Validate adhesion, passage, entry position and downstream movement separately. The interface must still reject crossing when no physical route exists, even with a large chemokine signal. Drug target perturbations require receptor specific models; an idealized disabled adhesion gate is not a fitted simulation of any clinical drug.
Resident and recruited inflammatory myeloid cells

Human intestinal macrophage experiments support substantial phagocytic and bactericidal behavior with restrained inflammatory cytokine output. This does not mandate constitutive IL10 secretion from every resident cell. Use a tissue adapted program and spatial context rather than a universal M1 versus M2 label. [R04, R17]

EFFEROCYTOSIS reserves a contacted corpse; PHAGOCYTOSIS reserves accessible microbial material. CARGO_PROCESSING subsequently releases capacity according to a separate intracellular model. Inflammatory or regulatory cytokine induction requires specific output competence and an appropriate activation context. Successful cleanup can remove extracellular damage sources without issuing a global anti inflammatory command.

Track contact, uptake, cargo, processing, microbial survival, corpse persistence and secreted protein separately. The default priority emerges from channel rates and availability rather than a rule that every contact forces cytokine release. Processing completion alone does not prove microbial killing.

Initialize a recruited origin and an inflammatory program from the chosen patient or experimental context. Candidate outputs differ across states; one generic inflammatory macrophage should not automatically secrete every mediator. Spatial and single cell IBD evidence supports heterogeneity, not one universal conversion rate. [R03, R04]

Candidate induction routes include TNF, CCL2, OSM and IL23, with explicit competence. IL1B priming is separate from processing and active release. Human macrophage inflammasome findings must not be substituted for the human epithelial sensing contract. [R27] MYELOID_ADAPTATION requires sustained permissive context and retains recruited origin even when a resident like program develops.

CCL2 guided movement requires local receptor competence and a traversable route. The demonstration does not impose a universal six hour earliest arrival or a fixed threefold clearance defect. Compare recruitment, adaptation and output using matched sampling windows and independent protein measurements.

Use a neutrophil annotation supported by a marker panel, protein or morphology where possible. A cell is either explicitly infiltrated at initialization or enters through the vascular reservoir. Spatial myeloid evidence and vascular recruitment studies constrain different parts of this representation. [R04, R19]

The cell can follow an accessible CXCL8 associated gradient, engulf a contacted target, process cargo and release a finite local granule packet. Local proliferation is not licensed. Receptor desensitization, chemoattractant hierarchies and swarming are optional extensions requiring their own state and transport rules; the current kernel does not claim to implement them merely by drawing convergent motion.

Human neutrophil IL1B contributed to epithelial extrusion in an infected organoid setting. That provides one conditional route, not an instruction to extrude all stressed cells. [R16] Age and context influence survival in a fitted model; the default does not delete every neutrophil at one universal lifespan. NET formation and lytic death are not silently equated or enabled.

Separate dendritic identity from macrophage identity and retain subtype uncertainty. CD1C, FCER1A and presentation genes may guide annotation, but no single marker proves the full functional state. A generic human cDC2 is not defined as obligatorily CD103 positive. [R01, R03]

The cell acquires accessible material, processes it and presents a defined antigen through host antigen machinery. New uptake is not instant presentation. DC_EXIT requires a reachable lymphatic route, appropriate migration competence and a prepared state. The completion transaction removes or transfers the agent with population accounting.

The current local model does not implement naive T cell priming, germinal center reactions or a guaranteed return wave. An external adaptive module may supply such processes with measured delays and conditional outcomes. It must not turn every exiting DC into a predetermined Th17, Treg or plasma cell wave on day five.

This entry represents a previously primed or tissue adapted helper state, not a naive cell awaiting specification. IL17 related markers and cytokine competence should be assigned within the selected human dataset and context. Crohn associated state data and epithelial cytokine experiments support different parts of the proposed circuit. [R03, R14]

TH17_IL17_INDUCTION requires a verified activation route and IL17A output competence. A conventional antigen driven route needs compatible presentation and contact. A bystander route needs a separately supported receptor contract. IL23 exposure does not instantly generate a mature Th17 lineage from an arbitrary lymphocyte. The reference clock concerns new output in an already eligible state.

Continuous cytokine output can persist at a finite rate while the cell remains viable and supplied. It does not require the cell to emit a new discrete packet every tick or become obligatorily silent for a generic refractory period. New induction, output decay, secretion rate and motility are separate variables.

Initialize an appropriate previously primed helper program with candidate IFNG competence, for example using TBX21 and CXCR3 in a broader panel. These markers do not establish current secretion or antigen specificity. [R03, R14]

TH1_IFNG_INDUCTION follows a verified activation event and an explicit synthesis clock. Recipient cells respond only through their own competence and accessible IFNG field. A macrophage does not become maximally inflammatory merely because a Th1 labeled neighbor exists. The same helper cell can move if the route and channel rules permit it, subject to contacts needed for the particular activation mechanism.

Validate encounter history, induced protein output, recipient activity and tissue consequences separately. Local helper proliferation is not enabled in this version because its activation and cycle model is not specified. A future clonal expansion module should inherit lineage and antigen history rather than introducing unrelated cells as random replacements.
Regulatory T cells and CD8 intraepithelial lymphocytes

Use a regulatory program and appropriate functional context rather than treating FOXP3 RNA as a direct suppression coefficient. Human spatial data can constrain localization. Contact regulation has a distinct experimental mechanism: CTLA4 on the regulatory cell can remove CD80/CD86 from the opposing cell. [R01, R06, R26]

TREG_CONTACT_REGULATION requires a verified target contact, CTLA4 competence, relevant target ligands and activation. Its completion changes target costimulation through a bounded host transaction. TREG_IL10_INDUCTION is a separate soluble route requiring output competence; recipient response is not automatic. No fixed universal 100 µm suppression radius is imposed.

Moving a Treg in the simulation changes its contact opportunities and accessible soluble signals, not a global suppression field attached to its label. Compare local activation, pathogen control and collateral damage rather than assuming that less inflammation is always a better outcome.

The default is a conservative, previously primed conventional CD8 intraepithelial lymphocyte model. It does not represent every αβ, γδ or unconventional IEL program. Atlas identity and spatial position identify a candidate population but do not estimate its killing hazard. [R01, R02]

IEL_CYTOTOXIC_HIT requires contact, host verified TCR target recognition, cytotoxic competence and a finite store. A delivered hit is not guaranteed target death. The target follows its own damage, repair and execution contract. NKG2D associated stress recognition alone does not replace the conventional TCR gate in this default model.

The cell cannot read hidden intracellular infection variables that have no presentation or surface signal. Contact duration, delivered cargo, target response and completed death are separate observations. The host must account for disengagement, target movement and store recovery before serial target attacks can be interpreted quantitatively.

Keep NK identity distinct from T cell identity even when they share cytotoxic machinery. The dictionary uses a contextual NKG7, KLRD1 and GNLY panel, while recognition competence is supplied separately. A transcript panel is not a complete activating and inhibitory receptor model. [R01, R02]

NK_CYTOTOXIC_HIT requires physical contact, a host verified balance of activating and inhibitory signals, adequate effector competence and available cytotoxic cargo. It does not use TCR specificity, nor does it treat low target health as sufficient recognition. NK_IFNG_INDUCTION requires its own verified activation and output competence.

The proposed contact clock ends in a delivered hit rather than immediate deletion of the target. Host target susceptibility and death timing remain separate. A numerical setting chosen to preserve an attractive epithelial image is not a fitted killing rate. Quantify contacts, hits, target deaths, inhibited encounters and resource depletion.

The single ILC3 in the synthetic preset is one agent, not an estimate of population diversity. Candidate IL1 and IL23 responsiveness and IL22 output require a compatible initialized state. This is distinct from direct sensing of every pathogen in the lumen. [R01]

ILC3_IL22_INDUCTION requires verified activation and output competence. The resulting field can engage an eligible epithelial response after transport and receptor processing. The epithelial defence program, progenitor behavior and organoid growth are separate consequences. Experimental IL22 findings do not justify a universal stem or progenitor proliferation bonus. [R12, R13]

Validate source output, recipient activity and downstream function independently. An IL22 removal experiment may have different net effects with different epithelial states and damage contexts. The simulation should not encode worsening barrier function as an unavoidable outcome merely because IL22 is labeled protective.

Initialize an existing antibody class and specificity. A plasma cell identity indicates secretory potential, but the antibody amount, antigen specificity and survival support remain model inputs. Human intestinal atlases provide cell context; they do not fit the continuous secretion rate used here. [R01, R02]

The optional antibody process produces a bounded amount into the lamina propria. Apical secretory IgA requires a compatible polymeric substrate and epithelial transport. IGA_TRANSCYTOSIS is disabled unless antibody and epithelial transport capabilities are implemented. The host must conserve transported substrate and distinguish the destination from the original compartment.

No new clone, affinity maturation or class switching is generated inside a minute by changing a cell label. A missing antibody module leaves this route inactive rather than depositing protective IgA into the mucus automatically. Compare antibody amount and location with a measured transport or secretion assay before interpreting a change in microbial access.

Ileal Crohn and stricturing Crohn datasets support IgG plasma cell associated inflammatory neighborhoods. That association helps define initialization and candidate interactions; it does not prove that every IgG producing cell causes persistent inflammation. [R03, R05]

The cell has an existing antibody identity and bounded output. A recipient Fc receptor pathway requires relevant immune complexes, accessible receptor competence and a defined activation contract. IgG concentration alone is not an automatic IL1B stimulus. The present local model does not implement antigen binding, immune complex formation or antibody affinity unless the host supplies those modules.

The distinction matters for intervention tests. Removing TNF while maintaining the initial cellular module does not justify hard coding persistent disease, nor does removing an IgG cell guarantee resolution. Compare alternative network assumptions and preserve the observation that the original human association is not a fitted causal rate law.
Optional epithelial sensors and antigen transport

These optional entries preserve a route to future perturbations without making every rare cell an active source in the default bacterial or Crohn demonstration. Their broad identities can be anchored in intestinal atlases. Specific sensing, receptor expression and secreted products require additional subtype and perturbation evidence. [R01]

TUFT_TYPE2_SIGNAL is disabled until the host implements a verified type 2 stimulus and output route. It does not assume that any bacterial exposure is a tuft stimulus. EEC_HORMONE_RELEASE requires a declared endocrine subtype output, a compatible nutrient stimulus and a finite store. One endocrine cell should not simultaneously produce every named gut hormone merely because it is labeled enteroendocrine.

These actions are extension contracts, not calibrated effects on stem proliferation, vascular behavior or immunity. Their default inactivity documents a limitation. Adding a hormone or alarmin requires its recipient competence, transport, resource budget, kinetics and a measurable downstream function.

An M cell belongs to a compatible follicle associated epithelial context with a receiving compartment. It should not be placed in every small crypt and villus patch simply to represent antigen transport. Atlas evidence identifies candidate populations; transport rates remain unestimated. [R01]

M_CELL_TRANSCYTOSIS is disabled unless antigen and epithelial transport modules are available. A permitted event transfers accessible apical material to the receiving pocket without requiring a generic barrier rupture. The target antigen or object must remain traceable through the transaction.

Absence of this optional cell does not prove that the model has excluded every physiological route of antigen sampling. Dendritic and macrophage handling, epithelial transport and other routes require their own scoped implementations. Do not use a missing M cell as a reason to invent a barrier defect whenever antigen presentation is needed.
Optional support cells and regional epithelial states

This is an optional regional annotation using a contextual BEST4, OTOP2 and CA7 panel. Its presence and position should come from the selected region and dataset, not from a rule that every microdomain must contain one representative. [R01, R02]

The dictionary preserves the identity and applicable generic epithelial safeguards. It does not claim to implement quantitatively correct pH or ion transport. Those functions require a transport model, substrates, membrane orientation and measurements. A molecularly named cell should not be assigned an arbitrary physiological bonus merely to make it visibly distinct.
Until those functions are added, count its optional role as unimplemented. Do not merge it silently with a generic enterocyte for a question specifically about that subset.

Pericytes can be placed at a vascular interface using a contextual RGS5, CSPG4 and PDGFRB panel. Enteric glial identity can be represented with an appropriate SOX10, S100B and PLP1 context. The atlas supplies candidate identity and location, not quantitative permeability or neuroimmune control in this microdomain. [R01, R02]

Two pericytes are included as support placeholders in the synthetic presets, but a contractile or vascular permeability effect needs a dedicated host module. Enteric glial outputs and recipient effects remain optional. The present version does not assign a fixed improvement in barrier integrity simply because a glial agent exists nearby.

For either extension, specify the sensed cue, output mechanism, target competence, event duration or continuous rate, resource cost and independent readout. If that evidence is missing, preserve an inactive capability rather than a generic beneficial multiplier. This is a smaller claim than simulating the complete stromal and neural environment, and it is the claim supported by this package.

Begin with explicit niche support, a declared vascular reservoir, baseline cell histories and bounded turnover. A localized injury changes an environmental condition or a documented subset of cells. The scenario may remove a known number of epithelial agents, but must record whether they are dead, shed or outside the observed domain. It must not script which macrophage acts or which target dies next.

The default human overlay distinguishes luminal exposure from intracellular sensing. Human epithelial findings are not replaced by a mouse epithelial circuit. The optional mouse overlay is disabled in the adult human preset. The supplied package does not model pathogen replication, evolutionary change or calibrated invasion kinetics; pathogen related variables are declared scenario or host inputs. [R16, R22, R23]

Use matched patient associated states when available, with site, treatment and disease context. Otherwise retain the synthetic label. Do not define Crohn disease as acute infection that never clears. A chronic state can reflect altered initial cellular programs, matrix and barrier conditions or external inputs, but its persistence should be measured across simulations rather than guaranteed by a permanent inflammatory flag. [R03, R05]

Initialize preexisting matrix where it is relevant. Enabling matrix remodeling requires deposition, degradation and mechanical feedback. A mucosal microdomain does not contain all layers necessary to model whole wall narrowing. Report local matrix change, not clinical stenosis, unless an additional multiscale model is fitted and validated. [R05]
Mechanism ablation is not drug pharmacology

Turning off a receptor route tests a modeled causal dependency. Setting a field to zero is an idealized perturbation, not a drug exposure model. Receptor occupancy, soluble and membrane targets, tissue penetration, dosing and off target effects are outside the supplied package. No rule makes early TNF removal successful or late removal unsuccessful by definition. The associations motivating the network cannot be reused as a mandatory simulated outcome. [R03, R18]
Perturb only what the scenario names

Record every external field injection, injury, reservoir change and parameter override with time, location, magnitude and provenance. Do not secretly alter repair rates to ensure resolution. Pair scenarios using the same initial state and compatible random number streams when estimating mechanistic differences.
Calibration: from observations to estimable parameters

Fit parameters in stages. First constrain geometry, observation coverage and initial composition. Then fit baseline turnover and movement. Next fit a small timed perturbation with measured events or protein outputs. Only then combine the broader patient associated inflammatory network. Fitting all hazards, durations, secretion strengths and transport coefficients to one final spatial image is generally not identifiable.
log L(event history) = Σ log h(event time) − ∫ H(t) dt

This point process expression applies to observed initiations under a specified hazard model. Completion durations need a separate likelihood. Right censored events contribute survival probabilities; interval censored events contribute probability over the observation window. A death first observed between two frames is not an exact death time. An agent absent from a later section may have moved, died or been missed by segmentation.
Separate biological variation from measurement error

Model donor, anatomical site, batch, lineage and measurement uncertainty explicitly. Hold out donors rather than random cells from the same donor. A clone or neighborhood must not leak into both fitting and evaluation as though its cells were independent subjects. Human spatial measurements and organoid live imaging may require linked but nonidentical parameter sets. [R01, R02, R11]
What a static snapshot can constrain

A snapshot can constrain state frequencies, spatial arrangements and distributions of measured markers under an observation model. Multiple combinations of initiation rates and residence times can produce similar frequencies. A pseudotime ordering or latent embedding is not a calibrated clock. Dynamic data, perturbation contrasts and external measurements help resolve those alternatives.

Normalize programs within appropriate cell types and technical contexts, then calibrate across donors. Do not set a hazard equal to an AUCell score, ligand receptor score or language model confidence. Evaluate the mapping using held out event or protein outcomes. Where data only support direction, retain a range of coefficient values rather than reporting a precise fitted coefficient.

Store posterior samples, bootstrap fits or an explicit plausible parameter ensemble. Repeat simulations across those parameter sets as well as random seeds. If a conclusion changes with the prior family or a modest transport change, report that dependence. A visually plausible single run is not evidence that the parameter vector is uniquely correct.
Validate the smallest causal loop first

A first biological benchmark should contain a defined injury or signaling perturbation, a known observation schedule and a limited set of measurable consequences. For example, evaluate whether an epithelial induction, vascular permission and leukocyte crossing sequence reproduces measured ordering without assigning lesion coordinates directly to the leukocyte. Recruitment and crossing should remain distinguishable. [R19]
Completed mitosis or lineage trace with elapsed full cycle.
MKI67 used as a completed division timestamp.
Did the cell die or extrude?
Active death readout, morphology, membrane state and location.
Every extrusion labeled apoptosis; every dead cell instantly deleted.
Protein output, location and sampling time.
Ligand RNA treated as a calibrated secretion rate.
Coverage, junctions, transport and wound geometry.
A repair score closes a gap without physical rearrangement.
Matched segmentation, marker panel and neighborhood statistics.
A visually similar UMAP treated as evidence of correct dynamics.

Remove secretory stores and immediate stored release should stop, while future synthesis may still occur. Disable an adhesion route and crossing should fail through that route even if chemotactic fields remain. Remove a required target contact and engulfment should cancel or pause according to its contract. These tests examine dependencies without imposing the final tissue outcome.

Vary decision interval, field resolution, domain dimensions, effective thickness, boundary distance, cell number and initialization. Preserve density and physical scaling when comparing different agent counts. Rare cell placement can dominate a 100 cell realization, so ensemble variability is essential. Compare alternative mechanisms that explain the same endpoint, rather than only tuning weights in one assumed network.
The distributed tests have a narrower scope

The package includes 43 passing software tests covering constraints, clocks, reservations, arithmetic, stale responses and simple field conservation. They use synthetic states and mock host receipts. They do not validate epithelial mechanics, real tissue homeostasis, Crohn progression, pathogen dynamics or clinical intervention outcomes. A reference implementation passing its own tests is a starting point, not a biological result.
Integration with the existing virtual tissue application

The inspected application material contains a limited cell action menu and a batch decision interface with tick, revision and cells. The newer contract preserves a batch boundary but separates action legality, initiation probability, event time and physical effect. It does not overwrite either supplied HTML file. [S03, S04]

Import virtual_tissue_kernel.mjs as an ES module and load virtual_tissue_rules_v2.json. Validate the JSON against its schema during development and run validateRegistry for cross references at runtime. Declare only the host capabilities actually implemented. Passing every capability name without implementing it defeats the contract.

A snapshot contains a stable cell identifier, type, tick, tissue revision, biological time in minutes, cell state, local signals and host context. Receptor competence and physical context need explicit provenance. The host should compute shared fields and contacts before constructing snapshots. A rendering frame or a remote response does not advance biological time.

The kernel proposes event initiations within a chosen interval. The host resolves proposals globally by time and reservations, then calls start to revalidate legality. It advances ongoing events using current continuation context. The duration is sampled once. At completion the kernel produces a transaction plan, not a command that bypasses physics.

The host checks target and geometry constraints, applies state changes, consumes reserved resources, updates counts and fields, increments revision and acknowledges the transaction. Failed transactions change nothing and remain pending until retried or explicitly cancelled. A completed event must not be applied twice. A stale snapshot cannot spend the same store again.

The host owns contact detection, epithelial mechanics, barrier permeability, intracellular sensing variables, immune recognition, target objects, vascular geometry, population changes and measurement rendering. The rule package can be used without optional modules: dependent actions then remain unavailable with an explicit reason. It is therefore directly loadable, but not a universal drop in replacement for any tissue simulator.

Run node test_kernel.mjs, then node run_demo.mjs inside the package directory. The second command demonstrates delayed output induction in one synthetic epithelial cell. It is deliberately not presented as a 100 cell tissue run. The integration guide documents the API and the missing host responsibilities.
Legacy actions, provider contracts and safe operation
Map only to eligible epithelial CXCL8 induction. Entry still requires the vascular route.
Use one finite store release contract. Intensity changes require an explicit budget parameter.
Reject an automatic mapping. Separate reversible injury, death execution and coordinated extrusion.
Require a species and cell specific sensing, processing and release contract.
Require a named mediator, output competence and release compartment.
Require verified NK or T cell recognition. Stress alone is insufficient.

These changes are a migration specification based on inspected application snippets, not a claim that the existing HTML has been patched or fully tested. The application may need additional state fields, new cell types, event logs and physics handlers before an action can be enabled. [S03, S04]

A provider receives only the eligible vocabulary and a compact local snapshot. It may select among permitted options or explain an already computed event. It cannot invent actions, change durations, alter hazards from a confidence score or update the tissue directly. The response carries the original tick and revision, and its choices are rechecked at commit. The legacy application may need an adapter to echo or attach these fields.

A semantic score about plausible behavior is not a measured event probability per minute. Keep a deterministic local fallback and a fixed numerical event model. A model used only for narration can describe logged events without being part of the causal simulation. No external model API is invoked by this package.

Use deidentified data and avoid sending patient metadata to external providers. Version the registry, schema, host engine, source datasets, observation model, random seeds and overrides. Log rejected actions as well as completed ones. Numerical stability errors should stop or explicitly degrade the simulation, not be hidden by clipping or silent resets.

New evidence can change a receptor route, state annotation or clock prior. Each change should identify the affected actions, test failures, calibration impact and migration path. The original source remains in the audit trail even when the implemented interpretation changes.
How to read the operational action catalogue

The following catalogue is generated from the same JSON used by the reference kernel. Action identifiers, cell eligibility, clocks, hazard scales, costs and source references therefore remain aligned with the machine readable specification. The full nested predicates and effects are in the JSON; the catalogue explains the central contract in a form suitable for scientific review.
An action record has nine distinct responsibilities

It identifies the cell states that may act, the host capability required, the current gate, the trigger, the score and hazard, the event duration, shared locks and costs, continuation behavior and the completion effect. These are distinct even when a short user interface label hides them behind one button. A button labeled release alarm must not bypass an induction clock or create a protein that has no processing route.

An atlas reference indicates support for state or spatial context. A mechanistic reference supports the cited experimental relationship. Neither supplies the numerical hazard scale printed in the catalogue. All distributed hazard scales, thresholds, costs and duration distributions are P. Actions with no adequate mechanistic reference remain explicit implementation abstractions rather than being attributed to an unrelated paper.

A capability such as epithelial_mechanics, immune_recognition or antibody names work that must be implemented by the host. It is not an assertion that the reference kernel performs that work. Completion effects are typed intents. A run cannot be described as executing cytotoxic recognition if the host merely sets the corresponding boolean to true for every stressed target.

The catalogue names a duration model whose full support is given earlier. The clock starts when that action is initiated, not necessarily when the tissue was first perturbed. An external stimulus, a field change, receptor activation and event initiation can be separated by transport, sensing, integration and stochastic waiting. A single latency from injury to visible output should be decomposed before fitting.

A change in output capacity is not yet an extracellular amount. A delivered hit is not completed target death. An engulfed object is not necessarily killed. A lineage transition requires functional maturation and appropriate host placement. A completed event with failed geometry remains pending or is explicitly cancelled according to policy; it is not silently retried with a shorter clock.

Start with one cell type and one measurable action. Fit its gate assumptions, event initiation and duration to an appropriate experiment. Add recipients and transport only after the isolated response is checked. The catalogue is broad enough for expansion, but enabling every action at once would make the first calibration problem harder to identify.

S01. Intestinal_Cell_Decision_Playbook.docx, version 1.0, 19 September 2026, 24 pages, together with Intestinal_Cell_Rule_Registry.json. This source supplied the original human ileal scope, evidence labels, datasets, timing observations, explicit numerical priors and most of the cell contracts.

This source supplied the expanded licence and kinetics structure, broader cell dictionary, neighborhood and provider framing. Its numerical and biological claims were reconciled explicitly rather than copied unchanged.

S03. vilopolis.html, inspected Library source. The inspected sections contain the cell specific MENU, local allowed checks and heuristic scoring. The final package records migration mappings but does not replace the file.

S04. Cellville_Intestino.html, inspected Library source. The inspected sections contain the batch request to /api/decide using tick, revision and cells, local fallbacks and world.commit. Full application behavior and compatibility were not tested in this consolidation.
Files are bound by content hashes

The operational registry records SHA256 hashes of the two supplied DOCX sources and the original JSON. This distinguishes the exact inputs used from a later document with the same display name. Source observations remain traceable to their reference identifiers. The generated package has a manifest with hashes for the final files.

No clinical pharmacology, whole wall intestinal mechanics, neural circuit, complete microbiota community, pathogen replication, de novo adaptive priming, B cell selection or patient specific parameter fit is supplied. Optional cell functions need additional evidence and host modules. The default scalar fields are simplified proxies, not measurements of the extracellular proteome.
What counts as the next scientific advance

The next useful result is not a more animated tissue. It is a reproducible comparison between a small calibrated rule set and held out observations, with competing explanations and uncertainty. An adequate first benchmark could identify a response delay, test a contact dependency or quantify recruitment path timing in a matched experiment. Those results can then justify expanding the network.
